Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original

delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The bidder shall have an authorized service centre of the OEM in Andaman & Nicobar Islands. 2. The service centre must have been operational for a minimum of 03 years as of the date of bid submissi on. Documentary evidence (Such as OEM Authorization, GST registration, certificate of service centre, addr ess, and field service report of the DG set for the past 03 years i.e, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) should b e submitted along with the technical bid. 3. The bidder shall furnish the list of items required during the warranty period, which will be supplied by t he buyer. 4. The firm shall submit a satisfactory performance report/certificate issued by the concerned Government Department/PSU, confirming satisfactory supply, installation and/or performance of the DG Set(s) supplied by the firm. 5. The place of supply is Office of the Divisional Forest Officer, Nicobar Division, Campbell Bay which is aro und 600 Km from Sri Vijaya Puram. There is no road connectivity in between, and the only way to transport the DG is by ship. .
